dct_description_sm: The objectives are to 1) Improve our knowledge of the ecology of berry producing species and monitor berry productivity (g/m) in relation to environmental change; 2) Document natural variability in distribution and abundance of berry producing species; 3) Establish long-term berry monitoring in collaboration with communities and schools; and 4) Develop protocols in collaboration with members of the communities and schools, for a long term monitoring of berry productivity.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Berry picking
dct_title_s: Community-based berry productivity monitoring in the context of climate change at Pangnirtung, Nunavut
